hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; for p in "$d/.venv/bin/python" "$d/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" "$d/.kt-scaffold/hooks/prompt_ingress_guard.py" --client claude-code; done; for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$d/.kt-scaffold/hooks/prompt_ingress_guard.py" --client claude-code; done; echo 'Guvenlik denetimi baslatilamadi, cunku bu bilgisayarda calisan bir Python bulunamadi. Islem durduruldu. Python programini kurumun uygulama katalogundan kurun, proje klasorundeki Python ortamini (.venv) hazirlayin ve yeniden deneyin.' >&2; exit 2
